notes.title: 20240429 - Replay System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114456/dc0e0bb124c1dcd85141614fbb31c94870529b83.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

The replay system has gotten some overhaul, the vision is that you as a drone pilot should be able to access the same tooling I have when developing this game or making the Youtube dev logs. I.e. If I need something to record a certain angle I will add that function to the replay system of the game so that you also have access to it when creating content from the game.

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added tooltip to the pause menu of the replay system.
[*] Multiple camera perspectives(listed below).
[*] Fixed bug when transitioning between 1st person view and 3rd person in game.
[/list]

[b]Perspectives added:[/b]

[list]
[*] FPV Camera perspective.
[*] Selfie Perspective.
[*] 3rd person perspective.
[*] 3rd person perspective with joystick input for orbiting the drone.
[*] Free look where the spectators rotation is affected.
[*] Free look with where the pitch of the spectator is static but pitch angle of camera is changed.
[*] Free look orbit, you can move the position of origin with WSAD, rotate around with joysticks as well as adjust the camera boom length.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to droneville
notes.content:
Thanks for waiting!

We are thrilled to announce that we have managed to migrate to an open world level design,
in future updates you will see how the world grows with more content.

Stay tuned for more.


So what is new in this version:

[list]
[*] Map update, landscape background.
[*] Max camera angle is now 90deg.
[*] Track time delta fades out.
[/list]

notes.title: Crash into the new year
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114456/b0f73690f229dd39c7185bccd4461c8f337b702d.gif[/img]

[b]Merry X-mas and happy new year![/b]

This was one tough update to pull of, We hope you will enjoy the improvements.  Stay tuned for more!

[list]
[*] Drones can now be crashed! and may respawn after a few seconds, this gives you as a player a sense of value at stake when freestyling or racing. Record your spectacular crashes and post to disc!
[*] Bugfix, working hard on an issue where if the server owner would change track layout this was not replicated to the clients. Also, only host can change map from now on.
[*] Drones emit toon smoke while flying near the ground, very satisfying. This is replicated to all of the clients, show of your fly low skills!
[*] Sound effects now creates a richer experience.
[*] Menu system update.
[*] Find server, refresh is now started as soon as you open the find server.
[/list]
